basic_info.description: Located in prime Liberty Hill, 3364 21st Street is a classic Victorian triplex boasting architectural charm and period details. The vacant top-floor residence features two bedrooms, one bath, and approximately 1,035 sq. ft. (per graphic artist). Soaring ceilings and south-facing windows bathe the home in natural light, while the open kitchen/living area extends to a private deck with sweeping downtown views and direct garden access. The tenant-occupied middle unit offers two bedrooms, one bath, a formal living room, and a rear deck with garden access. The tenant-occupied lower unit includes one bedroom, one bath, a spacious walk-in closet, and a deck that opens to the shared garden. Set just a half-block from the vibrant Valencia Street corridor, residents are steps from some of the city's best restaurants, cafes, and boutiques. Dolores Park is two blocks away, with Noe Valley just south of the property. Excellent transit options include nearby MUNI, BART, and convenient freeway access. Walk Score of 99 - truly a walker's paradise. 1 vacant unit + 2 tenant-occupied units. 4.9% CAP rate, 13.19 GRM.
